title: Seedcut
summary: Start: enter Seedcut. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Orchard Cutter. Do: come within 320 meters of the Orchard Cutter. The cutter orbits stolen vaults. The night stock is the black market. Finish: after the cutter is met, come inside Night Orchard's shell. Black Sail heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
